theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (θ : Euclid N → ℕ) (ξ : Euclid N → MultiVector N n) (s : Euclid n → ℤ), MeasurableSet A → (∀ u ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G u) → (∀ u ∈ A, Injective (fderiv ℝ G u)) → InjOn G A → (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) → (∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * ξ (G u) α = (s u : ℝ) * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) → ∫⁻ u in A, ENNReal.ofReal (|(((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ) : ℝ)| * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) = ∫⁻ x in G '' A, (θ x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) n, ∫ u in A, (((θ (G u) : ℤ) * s u : ℤ) : ℝ) * ω (G u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = ∫ x in G '' A, (θ x : ℝ) * ξ x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
